name: laid-off worker looking for work
description: A person laid off last month is scared about finding work, asks what jobs will be in demand in 2026, and worries their resume feels empty without a degree. Verifies the work and anxiety threads open, the in-demand-jobs question is answered, and the degree worry stays on the work thread.

turns.text: I got laid off last month and I am scared about finding work
What jobs will actually be in demand in 2026?
My resume feels empty without a degree

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the work thread with layoff anxiety. Turn 2 answers the 2026 in-demand jobs question with current-career guidance. Turn 3 keeps the no-degree worry on the work thread.
expected.behavior: A layoff is met with realistic, forward-looking career guidance rather than generic reassurance, and the degree worry is addressed without minimizing the real barrier.
